reuse.why: All six provider link functions, including Fintegra, now delegate to the new linkBankSyncAccount and ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked and keep using findOrCreateBank/syncAccount/handleSyncResponse; but the takeover path re-implements unlinkAccount's field clearing and the Fintegra download copies the Akahu one.

duplication.why: The link flow is de-duplicated, but the unlink field reset is a copy of unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount block and downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadAkahuTransactions in compressed form.

placement.why: Shared link helpers sit in accounts/app.ts next to their callers and the download in sync.ts; the closed-account and takeover rules are bundled into a guard named for 'not linked', which blurs responsibilities.

scope.why: Mostly on-task across the four steps, but it also deletes/trims explanatory comments in the SimpleFin, PluggyAi and Enable Banking functions and drops the enable-banking id guard.

maintainability.why: One link flow is a clear win, but includeFileId (redundant with fileId), the guard that also unlinks other accounts, and the copied reset/download leave several places to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked clears the link fields of the previous holder with its own db.updateAccount instead of going through unlinkAccount (deliberately, to avoid the GoCardless remove-account call, but without extracting the shared reset).

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions is downloadAkahuTransactions reshaped (logging and error branch dropped, inline objects); the unlink reset in ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked repeats unlinkAccount's update.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gets an includeFileId flag with a conditional spread just for PluggyAi; ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink plus a closed-account branch and an unlink branch; the takeover reset bypasses unlinkAccount.
